sections.heading: Intro
sections.content_markdown: Skill practice is a primary domain, performed BEFORE Superset A when active. Not part of Movement Prep.

sections.heading: Rules (GTG-style)
sections.content_markdown:
Daily or near-daily practice (low fatigue)
Never to failure
Perfect technique, stability, time-under-tension required for progression
Always at start of session, fresh nervous system
Volume: 3–5 sets · sub-maximal · long rest between attempts

sections.heading: Active Ladders (per Plan Q1 2026)
sections.content_markdown:
Lower-body skill: Pistol Squat progression (assisted → box → free)
Upper pull: L-sit → Tuck Lever → Front Lever (weeks 9–12 priority)
Upper push: Pseudo Planche Push-Up → Tuck Planche

sections.heading: Decision Rule
sections.content_markdown:
Only progress to next ladder step when current step holds with:
clean technique · stable position · target time-under-tension
ROM regression or shake = hold current step
